name: Avery
bio: Avery of Augusta, Me., called at the Cow Boy office in February 1884 while the editor was away. In April 1884 the paper reported that a Mr. Avery, who had been visiting A. M. Sinnott for some time, had returned east.

moments.label: Called at the Cow Boy office

mentions: Messrs. Jones, of Deadwood; Meeks, of Sully, and Avery, of Augusta, Me., called during our absence. We regret not having seen the gentlemen and hope they will call again when we are “to hum.”
Father Cassidy, of Mandan, is visiting Geo. Fitzgerald.
Mr. Avery, who has been visiting A. M. Sinnott for some time, has returned east.
